title: Verify authenticated private Space coach settings acceptance

source.ref: Private context release dependency for LIVE-1332

detail:
Owner applies the additive coach_profile column to existing service-role-only space_private_state through the normal migration process after isolated DB proof. Run supabase/tests/space_coach_profile_private.test.sql in a disposable migrated database first, then verify schema/grants and authenticated two-Space save/clear/read isolation in the rollout environment. No live SQL was applied by this implementation. Missing schema currently shows unavailable and logs a bounded failure; never substitute public preferences.

2026-10-25 migration gap repair includes reviewed additive storage migration25000 and its eight-assertion pgTAP probe. Offline PostgreSQL assertions pass; required full-schema CI and live schema/grants verification remain part of rollout. Coach settings/authenticated two-Space UI remain unpublished in the separate AI phases; storage readiness must not imply those features are live.

2026-10-26 production receipt from the release owner: migrations20270346024600 and20270346025000 are applied and the ledger reconciles at857; anonymous and authenticated roles cannot select private coach context. Storage prerequisite is satisfied. Keep this row open for authenticated editor save/clear/read across two Spaces, unrelated-owner denial and public-page non-disclosure after the separate Space coaching UI is published. Applying storage does not establish UI acceptance.

verify.evidence: Release owner verified production25000/schema ledger857 and anon/auth private-column privileges false. Source/mocked two-tenant storage, gated settings page and action tests pass separately. Authenticated production UI and public-page non-disclosure acceptance remain pending.
